verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet operations, teleoperation and observability platform, so simulation support is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions simulation, a simulator integration, or running the same code against simulated and physical robots. Agent features such as Docker or ROS installs and a configurable ROS_MASTER_URI are adjacent agent setup, not a sim-to-real capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can run the same robot code against simulation and the real robot without a rewrite
